rules.name: is_style_colocated
rules.instructions: Does this stylesheet style COMPONENT behavior via global selectors? Component behavior (hover/active/disabled/selected states; presentation of buttons, rows, triggers) must be styled at the component (Tailwind classes on the element). Global element or attribute selectors - button:not(:disabled), [data-slot=...], .component-class rules that set behavior states - are a second style authority and a violation. NOT violations: @theme token definitions (palette, spacing), base document styles (body, html), non-behavioral resets, and theme assignments to vendor token classes (.hljs-comment etc.).

criteria.true: The file contains at least one global element/attribute selector that styles component behavior (e.g. button:not(:disabled), [data-slot="button"], a .component class setting hover/selected/active states).
criteria.false: No such selector: only @theme tokens, base document styles, non-behavioral resets, and vendor-class theme assignments.

rules.name: is_literal_shared
rules.instructions: The same literal value (string, number, regex) carrying the same meaning at two or more separate places in this TypeScript file should be written once as a named constant in this file and referenced at each place: the identical raw literal at distinct sites is drift waiting to happen. Judge what is observable: identical raw literals at distinct sites where one constant could carry that value to all of them. Brevity of a literal alone is not a defect; imports and identifiers are not literals; recurring words from a shared vocabulary - a styling class string, a prop or option value, an event, sort-key, or mode name, a typeof guard comparison string, an error-code name - are per-site uses of a convention, not one value flowing between sites.

criteria.true: At least one literal value appears as the same raw literal in two or more distinct places where the sites share that value, and no single named constant in this file carries it to all of them.
criteria.false: Every literal that appears in more than one place flows through one named constant defined in this file, or no literal repeats.
